context_files_read.purpose: Confirm repository-level bootstrap and phase ceiling.
key_findings: The automatic phase loop stops after P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100.
P14_SCALE_1000_OPTIN_DRYRUN is explicitly not automatic.

context_files_read.purpose: Read controlling repository instructions and safety boundaries.
key_findings: Default development phases are capped at 100 nodes.
Host network, firewall, routing, interface, and unrelated process mutation is forbidden.
Fake-only gates must never be presented as real Valkey evidence.
Harness controls must not be weakened, bypassed, deleted, or hidden through lock-file edits.

context_files_read.purpose: Confirm original phase loop and P14 opt-in requirements.
key_findings: P14 may only run when explicitly opted in and VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN equals I_UNDERSTAND_THIS_IS_NOT_A_DEFAULT_GATE.
Gate results must be produced by scripts/codex_gate.py run, not manually marked PASS.

context_files_read.purpose: Check fake/real phase boundaries, maximum node limits, and P14 status.
key_findings: default_max_nodes is 100.
P00-P02 allow fake-only bootstrapping; P03-P13 require real Valkey evidence where capability gates apply.
P14 is automatic false, real_valkey_required false, max_nodes 1000, and guarded by an explicit opt-in shell test.
P12 and P13 require real scale evidence at 10/30/50/100 nodes with data-path checks.

context_files_read.purpose: Review CI coverage that must not be weakened.
key_findings: CI compiles harness scripts, runs codex precheck --all, runs safety_scan.py, and runs unit tests.

CI runs compileall, precheck, safety scan, postcheck compatibility, unit/CLI, config/planner, integration/fault/failover/orchestrator, and analysis/report/stability/scale tests on Python 3.9 and 3.11.
Every stage must pass previous harness before current harness work.
Harness changes require an explicit change request and review approval if they touch existing controls.
Agent outputs must be persisted as JSON artifacts.

context_files_read.purpose: Read stage execution sequence and artifact requirements.
key_findings: L00 must persist read context, previous harness results, subagent outputs, validation, anti-regression review, and stage result.
Current-stage harness must be developed before implementation.
risk_auditor must identify drift, forgery, skip, resource exhaustion, dry-run confusion, and harness weakening risks.
Valid verdict values are APPROVED, CHANGES_REQUESTED, and BLOCKED.

context_files_read.purpose: Read previous harness, artifact-first, real Valkey, and anti-regression requirements.
key_findings: Real Valkey evidence must include real_valkey true, 9.1.x version, required observed node count, data-path proof, cleanup PASS, and schema validation PASS.
1000+ is not an automatic real gate and must remain dry-run/resource/planner unless separately opted in.
Anti-regression checks must inspect tests, scripts, schemas, workflows, codex, artifacts/gates, and artifacts/phases.

context_files_read.purpose: Read L00 stage scope and acceptance criteria.
key_findings: L00 must add or strengthen schemas/loop_engineering/*.schema.json, scripts/loop_engineering_validate.py, tests/loop_engineering/test_loop_state_contract.py, and tests/ci/test_loop_engineering_pack.py.
L00 must validate stage_result.json, subagent JSON, and commands.jsonl.
L00 must provide a runnable anti-regression guardian entry point.

context_files_read.purpose: Read validation commands and resource-sensitive gate boundaries.
key_findings: L00 validation includes scripts/loop_engineering_validate.py --root artifacts/loop_engineering and pytest for tests/loop_engineering plus tests/ci/test_loop_engineering_pack.py.
Resource preflight failure must not be converted into PASS.
1000+ dry-run artifacts must not count as real Valkey coverage.

context_files_read.purpose: Read expected loop artifact layout and JSON/JSONL contracts.
key_findings: commands.jsonl requires one JSON object per command with timestamps, cwd, command array, exit_code, stdout/stderr tails, and status.
stage_result.json must capture subagent verdicts, command log path, real/fake gates, artifacts, and remaining risks.
Stage is IN_PROGRESS in PREVIOUS_HARNESS phase.
Files touched so far are loop-engineering startup/read-context/state artifacts.
No blockers are recorded.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect previous harness outcome and environment notes.
key_findings: Previous harness is recorded as PASS after rerunning pytest commands in a temporary venv.
The first pytest command failed because the system python3 lacked pytest; this must remain visible in command provenance.

context_files_read.purpose: Inspect current stage read context and already-observed risks.
key_findings: Existing read context notes absent global_loop_state.json and absent L00 validation resources.
Existing read context notes untracked artifacts/.DS_Store and codex/.DS_Store.
The log records an initial pytest FAIL followed by venv creation, dependency installation, editable install, and rerun PASS entries.
Each observed command line is JSONL with command arrays and status fields.

findings.description: Fake and real evidence boundaries can be blurred if future loop audits treat phase summaries, reports, or dry-run outputs as proof of real Valkey execution.
evidence: AGENTS.md requires real Valkey e2e proof from P03 onward and forbids fake-only gates being presented as real evidence.
codex/loop_engineering/03_HARNESS_POLICY.md requires real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x version, observed node count, data-path proof, cleanup PASS, and schema validation PASS.
codex/phase_manifest.json marks P03-P13 real_valkey_required true except fake-only P00-P02 and opt-in dry-run P14.

findings.description: P14 could be accidentally pulled into automatic validation or counted as real 1000-node evidence unless L00 locks automatic=false, opt-in env, dry-run, and max-node invariants into validation.
evidence: README.md and CODEX_START_HERE.md both state P14 is not automatic.
codex/phase_manifest.json has P14 automatic false and a require_1000_opt_in gate.
codex/loop_engineering/05_VALIDATION_COMMANDS.md states 1000+ dry-run artifacts must not be counted as real Valkey coverage.

findings.description: L00 is explicitly about harness bootstrap, so the highest regression risk is weakening existing harness controls while adding new validator scripts, tests, schemas, or CI coverage.
evidence: AGENTS.md identifies codex/phase_manifest.json, scripts/*.py, schemas/**/*.json, templates/**/*, docs/codex/**/*, and .github/workflows/codex-gates.yml as protected harness controls.
codex/loop_engineering/00_OPERATING_CONTRACT.md allows harness changes only with a change request and stronger or equivalent coverage.

codex/loop_engineering/03_HARNESS_POLICY.md defaults anti-regression blocking on required-to-optional, real_valkey_required false, min-node lowering, schema enum loosening, and hand-written PASS changes.

findings.description: Command-log provenance can become misleading if previous_harness_result.json summarizes PASS while commands.jsonl contains an earlier FAIL without an explicit recovery chain.
evidence: artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/L00_LOOP_ENGINE_HARNESS_BOOTSTRAP/commands.jsonl records an initial pytest FAIL due to missing pytest.
The same log records venv setup and rerun PASS entries.
previous_harness_result.json explains the temporary venv recovery in environment_notes.

findings.description: Untracked .DS_Store files under controlled artifact/codex paths can pollute commits or validation walks if not explicitly excluded or blocked.
evidence: git status --short reports untracked artifacts/.DS_Store and codex/.DS_Store.
find artifacts codex -name .DS_Store -print reports artifacts/.DS_Store and codex/.DS_Store.
The user explicitly called out working tree .DS_Store files as a risk focus.

findings.description: L00 completion is blocked until the validation resources named by the stage manifest exist and can validate loop state, subagent JSON, stage results, commands.jsonl, and anti-regression entry points.
evidence: rg over schemas, scripts, and tests found no existing matches for those L00 validation-resource paths.
codex/loop_engineering/05_VALIDATION_COMMANDS.md says L00 must first implement scripts/loop_engineering_validate.py if it does not yet exist.

proposed_harness.name: loop_subagent_output_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Validate every artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/*/subagents/*.json file for schema_version v1, known agent_role, required arrays, finding severities, harness types, and verdict enum.

proposed_harness.name: loop_command_log_schema_and_provenance
proposed_harness.acceptance: Validate commands.jsonl as strict JSONL with command arrays, timestamps, cwd, integer exit_code, status matching exit_code, stdout/stderr tails, and explicit recovery notes when a summary PASS includes earlier FAIL entries.

proposed_harness.name: loop_stage_state_and_result_schema
proposed_harness.acceptance: Validate stage_state.json and stage_result.json against loop contracts, including subagent verdicts, commands_log, previous/current harness booleans, real_valkey_gates, fake_gates, risks_remaining, commit_sha, and pushed.

proposed_harness.name: phase_manifest_safety_invariants
proposed_harness.acceptance: Assert default_max_nodes remains 100, automatic_stop_after remains P13_SCALE_LADDER_50_100, P14 remains automatic false and real_valkey_required false, and no automatic phase exceeds max_nodes 100.

proposed_harness.name: real_vs_dryrun_evidence_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Reject real coverage claims unless the source artifact is schema-valid real Valkey evidence with real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x version, required node count, data-path proof, cleanup PASS, and non-dry-run provenance.

proposed_harness.name: anti_regression_guardian_entrypoint
proposed_harness.acceptance: Provide a runnable anti-regression check that scans protected diff paths and blocks required-to-optional downgrades, real_valkey_required false changes, min-node reductions, schema loosening, hand-written PASS artifacts, and P14 automatic opt-in bypass.

proposed_harness.name: loop_engineering_ci_pack
proposed_harness.acceptance: CI coverage must assert the L00 validator, schemas, loop tests, and anti-regression entry point exist and can be executed without relying on chat-only state.

proposed_harness.name: ds_store_artifact_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Validation or anti-regression must fail if .DS_Store files are staged or included under codex, artifacts, schemas, scripts, tests, templates, docs, or workflow paths.

implementation_plan.step: Define loop-engineering schemas before relying on generated agent or stage artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: Schema-first validation prevents chat-only or manually shaped artifacts from being treated as accepted evidence.

implementation_plan.step: Implement the loop validator as a read-only artifact checker with explicit exit codes.
implementation_plan.rationale: L00 needs a deterministic validation entry point for state files, subagent outputs, stage results, command logs, and blocker conditions.

implementation_plan.step: Add tests for state contracts, command provenance, real/dry-run boundaries, P14 invariants, and .DS_Store guarding.
implementation_plan.rationale: These tests are the minimum protection against fake evidence promotion, opt-in bypass, and untracked local metadata leaking into committed artifacts.

implementation_plan.step: Wire anti-regression checks without weakening existing protected harness files.
implementation_plan.rationale: The stage requires a guardian entry point, but it must strengthen the existing safety model rather than replacing codex_gate.py, safety_scan.py, or CI gates.

acceptance_criteria: L00 must not be considered complete until scripts/loop_engineering_validate.py exists and passes against artifacts/loop_engineering.
L00 must not be considered complete until tests/loop_engineering/test_loop_state_contract.py and tests/ci/test_loop_engineering_pack.py pass.
Subagent JSON must validate with schema_version v1 and stage_id L00_LOOP_ENGINE_HARNESS_BOOTSTRAP.
commands.jsonl validation must preserve failed command entries and require explicit recovery evidence before a summarized PASS is accepted.
Any .DS_Store file staged or committed under controlled paths must block completion.
P14 must remain non-automatic, opt-in only, dry-run/resource/planner scoped, and excluded from real Valkey coverage.
Real Valkey coverage must require wrapper-produced evidence, live endpoint/version/data-path proof, required node count, cleanup PASS, and schema validation PASS.
No existing harness, workflow, schema, gate, or manifest requirement may be downgraded to make L00 pass.
risks: Block completion if any L00 validation-resource file is absent or only stubbed.
Block completion if P14 automatic changes to true, opt-in env checks are removed, or dry-run artifacts are counted as real evidence.
Block completion if fake tests, generated reports, or manually edited phase summaries are accepted as real Valkey proof.
Block completion if command logs are summarized without retaining command arrays, exit codes, stdout/stderr tails, and recovery chains.
Block completion if .DS_Store files are staged, committed, or included in artifact validation inputs.
Block completion if anti-regression checks modify protected harness controls without a documented harness_change_request and stronger equivalent coverage.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not manually write PASS into gate, stage, or validation result files to satisfy L00.
Do not skip failed baseline commands or omit failed command entries from commands.jsonl.
Do not relax schemas, CI jobs, phase_manifest gates, min-node requirements, or real_valkey_required flags.
Do not run P14 automatically or set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN inside L00 without explicit user opt-in.
Do not count P14 dry-run plans, resource estimates, or reports as real Valkey evidence.
Do not delete or ignore .DS_Store files by broad artifact exclusion if the files are staged; block and require cleanup outside this risk-auditor output.
Do not use report HTML, Markdown, or charts as source-of-truth for evidence.
commands_to_run: git diff -- tests scripts schemas .github codex artifacts/gates artifacts/phases artifacts/loop_engineering
notes: Approved to proceed to L00 harness design and implementation only under the blocker conditions above. The current missing L00 validation resources are expected pre-implementation gaps, not acceptable completion state. The existing .DS_Store files and the initial pytest failure in commands.jsonl must remain visible to validation and anti-regression checks rather than being hidden by summary artifacts.
